payload.reason: The evidence provides specific comparisons of the proposed model with existing models, particularly the Stochastic Answer Network (SAN) and its variants, as well as mentions of other existing machine reading comprehension (MRC) systems.

claims.text: The proposed model is compared to the Stochastic Answer Network (SAN) and its variants, showing improved performance metrics.
The model is also compared to existing MRC systems that extract answers by finding sub-strings in passages.
The proposed model achieves competitive results on the Stanford Question Answering Dataset (SQuAD) 2.0, indicating comparison with state-of-the-art models.
